paite: Huan Kanaan mi, kumpipa Arad simlam a om in, Atharim lampi ah Israel mite ahong pai uh chi a kigen ana za a; huchi in Israel mite ana dou a, galmat khenkhat anei hi.
heading: Kanaan Mite Tung a Vualzohna
english: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South, heard that Israel came by the way of Atharim. He fought against Israel, and took some of them captive.

paite: Israel mite'n TOUPA kiang ah thu achiam ua, "Ka khut ua hiai mite na hon piakleh akhuate uh ka hihmang ding uh," achi uh.
english: Israel vowed a vow to Yahweh, and said, “If you will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.”

paite: TOUPA'N Israel mite thu apom a, akiang uah Kanaan mite apia a, amau leh akhuate ahihmang uhi. Huai mun min Hormah asa uhi.
english: Yahweh listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. The name of the place was called Hormah.

paite: Hor tang a pan Tuipi San lam ah Edom gam kualkhum in apai ua; alampi ziak in mipi alunglel mahmah uhi.
heading: Dal Gul
english: They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. The soul of the people was very discouraged because of the journey.

paite: Mipite'n Pathian leh Mosi kalh in, "Gamdai a si dia bang ding a Aigupta a pan hon pikhia na hia? Tanghou lah om lou, tui lah om lou. Hiai tanghou kihhuai lah ka hinna un akih hi,” achi uh.
english: The people spoke against God and against Moses: “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread, there is no water, and our soul loathes this disgusting food!”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N mipi lak ah gul gukhahte asawl a, mite atu ua, Israel mite tampi asi uhi.
english: Yahweh sent venomous snakes among the people, and they bit the people. Many people of Israel died.

paite: Huaiziak in mite Mosi kiang ah ahong pai ua, "TOUPA leh nang kalh a ka na pau uh ka khialta uh, i lak ua gulte lamang ding in TOUPA kiang ah thum dih ve," achi uhi. Huchi in mite a ding in Mosi athum hi.
english: The people came to Moses, and said, “We have sinned, because we have spoken against Yahweh and against you. Pray to Yahweh, that he take away the serpents from us.” Moses prayed for the people.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Gul gukhah lim bawl inla, khuam lek ah khai in. Huan hichi ahi ding a, gultukmi peuhmah in huai a-et uleh adam ding uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Make a venomous snake, and set it on a pole. It shall happen that everyone who is bitten, when he sees it, shall live.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in dal gul abawl a, khuam lek ah akhai a; huan hichi ahong hi a, gultukmi peuhmah in huai dal gul a-et uleh adam uhi.
english: Moses made a serpent of bronze, and set it on the pole. If a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked at the serpent of bronze, he lived.

paite: Israel suante apai zel ua, Oboth ah giahphual asat uhi.
heading: Hor Tang A Pan Moab Phaizang
english: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth.

paite: Oboth a pan apai nawn ua, nisuahna lam Moab gamdai bul Ije-abarim ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise.

paite: Huai a pan apai nawn ua, Zered Phaizang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: From there they traveled, and encamped in the valley of Zered.

paite: Huai a pan apai nawn ua, Amorte gamgi a pan hong dawktuam gamdai a Arnon lehlam ah giahphual asat uhi. Arnon bel Moab gamgi, Moab leh Amorte kikal a om ahi.
english: From there they traveled, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that comes out of the border of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA kidounate laibu ah, Tuipi San leh Arnon luitate a;
english: Therefore it is said in The Book of the Wars of Yahweh, “Vaheb in Suphah, the valleys of the Arnon,

paite: Ar tenna a luangkhia luite leh Moab gamgi a omte ah athilhihte, achih.
english: the slope of the valleys that incline toward the dwelling of Ar, leans on the border of Moab.”

paite: Huai a pan Beer ah apai nawn ua; huai bel TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a mipite samkhawm inla, tui ka pe ding, achihna tuileh ahi.
english: From there they traveled to Beer; that is the well of which Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.”

paite: Huchi in Israelte'n hiai la asa uh. "Aw tuikhuk, hong kikhohkhia inla, athu la in sa un.
english: Then Israel sang this song: “Spring up, well! Sing to it,

paite: Dan petu in akawkmuh bang a miliante uleh mipite heutute'n akhetbuk uh toh alaih uh tuikhuk," chi in. Huchi in gamdai a pan Mattanah tan;
english: the well, which the princes dug, which the nobles of the people dug, with the scepter, and with their poles.” From the wilderness they traveled to Mattanah;

paite: Mattanah a pan Nahaliel ah; Nahaliel a pan Bamoth ah;
english: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;

paite: Bamoth a pan Moab lou a phaizang leh gamdai sunsuk Jeshimon lam nga Pisgah vum ah apai uhi.
english: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down on the desert.

paite: Israel mite'n Amorte kumpipa Sihon kiang ah mi asawl ua,
heading: Kumpipa Sihon Tung A Vualzohna / (Diu 2.26-3.11)
english: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

paite: "Na gam ah hon paisuaksak ve; lou ah hiam, grephuan ah hiam ka pial kei ding ua; tuileh tuite ka dawn kei ding uh. Na gam ka khen masiah uh Kumpipa Lamlian ah ka pai zel ding uh," chi in.
english: “Let me pass through your land. We will not turn away into field or vineyard. We will not drink of the water of the wells. We will go by the king’s highway, until we have passed your border.”

paite: Himahleh Sihon in Israel mite agam a apaisuak uh aphal kei hi. Sihon in amite tengteng akaikhawm vek a, Israel mite dou ding in gamdai ah akisazawta hi. Jahaz ava tung ua; huai ah Israel mite adou uh.
english: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz. He fought against Israel.

paite: Israel mite'n namsau in amah athat ua, agam Arnon a pan Jabok tan in, Ammon suante tan in alazou uhi. Ammon suante gamgi kulh nei ahih ziak in agam chiang lel alazou uhi.
english: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was fortified.

paite: Israel mite'n huai khua tengteng ala ua; Israel mite'n Amorte khua tengteng aluah uhi. Heshbon leh akhopel tengteng ah leng ateng uhi.
english: Israel took all these cities. Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.

paite: Heshbon khua bel Amorte kumpipa Sihon khua ahi. Amah huai ma a Moab kumpipa asual a akhut a pan gam tengteng, Arnon tan alaksakpa ahi.
english: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even to the Arnon.

paite: Huaiziak in paunak gente'n, "Heshbon ah hong pai in, kilam thak hen, Sihon khopi kilam thak hen, achi uhi.
english: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, “Come to Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and established;

paite: Heshbon a pan mei ahong pawt a, Sihon khopi a pan meikuang. Moab a Ar akang khin a, Arnon a mun sang a toupate toh.
english: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon. It has devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.

paite: Aw, Moab, na tung agik hi. Na mangthangta, Aw Kemosh mi! Ama'n Amorte kumpipa Sihon kiang ah tapate galtaite bang in leh atanute saltangte bang in apia hi.
english: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.

paite: Himahleh amau ka kap ua, Dibon tan in Heshbon amangthangta. Huchi in Nophah tan in ka hihmang uh, huai in Medeba tan apha hi."
english: We have shot at them. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon. We have laid waste even to Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba.”

paite: Huchibang in, Amorte gam ah Israel mite ateng uhi,
english: Thus Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.

paite: Mosi in Jazer enkhe ding in mi asawl a, akhuate ala ua, huai a teng Amorte ahawlkhia uhi.
english: Moses sent to spy out Jazer. They took its villages, and drove out the Amorites who were there.

paite: Akik nawn ua, Bashan lampi ah apaitou uh. Bashan kumpipa Og, amau dou ding in, amah leh amite tengteng, Edrei ah akisakhia uhi.
heading: Kumpipa Og Tung a Vualzohna
english: They turned and went up by the way of Bashan. Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Amah lau ke'n. Amah, amite tengteng leh agam na khut ah ka hon pe khinta hi. Heshbon a om Amorte kumpipa Sihon tung a na hih bang in na hih ding ahi,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Don’t fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people, and his land. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”

paite: Huchi in amah leh tapate hawi himhim nei lou in amite tengteng toh athat ua; agam aluahsakta uhi.
english: So they struck him, with his sons and all his people, until there were no survivors; and they possessed his land.
